title: What do you think of the output?
author: irshadtriton
selftext:
After the recent launch of Astra, I tried building a game and was honestly amazed. I first built a web version (ran out of tokens), then moved it to Godot.

I kept alternating between prompts like, “Change the seat color based on the reference image,” “Add this asset to replace the grass \[link\],” or “Add this asset to replace the water and improve the physics \[link\].”

Basically, I talk to ChatGPT, wait for it to build in Godot, and then see the updated version!

I tried learning game development before, but I could never find a proper guide. Most videos say, “Add a scene, click here, add a script, and write code,” and I’m like what is a scene in first place? then i google to understand... but this doesn't end, each and everything is something totally new and im not able to see any structured content to start from scratch! 

I’ve tried many times and honestly felt like giving up. I’d love some guidance on how to learn properly in a structured way.

I’ve attached what I built with the help of Astra after burning through an entire week of tokens! Since this is my first build, I’d also love your honest feedback. It’s okay if it’s bad...

I’m a Product person at work, not a technical person, so I’d love to know how I can improve and learn from here.
